rationale: Phase 6, the north star (LEARNING-SYSTEM.md §5): following several people at once — greetings, the hospitality ritual, overlapping small talk. Progressive scenes (2 → 4 speakers). Spoken Palestinian, written by Claude; NOT native-validated. Read + comprehend now; once per-line audio is generated (per-speaker voices), the continuous player turns it into real multi-party listening.

dialogues.scene: A guest, Khaled, arrives at Abu Sami's house in the evening. Welcomes, coming in, the first offer of coffee.

lines.en: Good evening!
Good evening! Welcome Khaled — you lit up the place!
God light upon you. How are you?
Praise God. Please, please — come in.
God keep you.

lines.ar: تفضّل استريح. شو بتشرب، قهوة ولا شاي؟
lines.en: Sit, relax. What'll you drink — coffee or tea?
Coffee, please.
Arabic coffee?
Yes, thank you.
One minute, I'll bring it.

questions.q: What does Abu Sami offer him to drink?

dialogues.scene: The food is ready. Umm Sami serves maqlube; the guest praises the cooking and blesses the cook.

lines.en: Come to the food — the table's ready.
Come on Khaled, please.

lines.ar: يا سلام، شو هالطبخ! ريحتها بتفتّح النفس.
lines.en: Wow, what cooking! The smell whets the appetite.
Enjoy. I made you maqlube.
Maqlube is the best dish!
Eat, eat — don't be shy.
Honestly I'm full, but it's really amazing.
Take a little more — there's still some.

lines.ar: يسلمو إيديكي يا أم سامي، أكل بيت بجد.
lines.en: Bless your hands, Umm Sami — real home cooking.
You're welcome. To your health.

questions.q: How does Khaled describe being full?
What does he say to the cook?

dialogues.scene: After eating, the family and the guest make small talk — work, kids, how fast time passes — four voices going.

lines.en: Khaled, how's work?

lines.ar: الحمد لله، ماشي الحال. مشغول شوي هالأيام.
lines.en: Praise God, getting by. A bit busy these days.

lines.ar: عمو خالد، لسا بتشتغل بنفس الشركة؟
lines.en: Uncle Khaled, still at the same company?

lines.ar: آه يا سامي، بس صار عندي شغل جديد كمان.
lines.en: Yes Sami, but I've got a new job on the side now too.

lines.ar: يعطيك العافية. وكيف العيلة، الأولاد كبروا؟
lines.en: More power to you. And how's the family — the kids grown?

lines.ar: كبروا والله. أكبر وحدة صارت بالجامعة.
lines.en: They've grown, honestly. The oldest is in university now.

lines.ar: ما شاء الله! الوقت بيمرق بسرعة.
lines.en: Mashallah! Time flies.
Right — it passes and we don't even notice.
Want some tea, uncle?
No thanks — that's plenty for me.

questions.a: He has a new job on the side as well.

questions.q: What does Sami offer at the end, and does Khaled accept?
